seq = open('region.fasta').read()
s = ''.join(seq.strip().split('\n')[1:]).upper()
L=len(s)
def rc(x): return x.translate(str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA'))[::-1]
STOPS=('TAA','TAG','TGA')

def runs(x, strand, mincod=60):
    out=[]
    for f in range(3):
        cur=f
        j=f
        while j+3<=len(x)-( (len(x)-f)%3 ):
            if x[j:j+3] in STOPS:
                if (j-cur)//3>=mincod:
                    out.append((cur,j,f,strand))
                cur=j+3
            j+=3
        if (len(x)-((len(x)-f)%3)-cur)//3>=mincod:
            out.append((cur,len(x)-((len(x)-f)%3),f,strand))
    return out

allr = runs(s,'+')+runs(rc(s),'-')
rows=[]
for a,b,f,strand in allr:
    if strand=='-':
        fa, fb = L-b, L-a   # 0-based forward start, end(exclusive)
    else:
        fa, fb = a, b
    frag = s[fa:fb] if strand=='+' else rc(rc(s)[a:b])
    nc = (b-a)//3
    p1=frag[0::3]; p2=frag[1::3]; p3=frag[2::3]

    rows.append((fa+1, fb, nc, strand, f+1, g(frag), g(p1), g(p2), g(p3)))
rows.sort()
print(f"{'start':>6}{'end':>7}{'aa':>5} {'strand':>7} {'frame':>6}  GC   GC1  GC2  GC3")
